obligations.obligation: Connect the BMS, IMD, BSPD interface, required interlocks, GLVMS, TSMS, three emergency buttons, BOTS and inertia switch in one series shutdown-current path.
obligations.verification_obligation: Inspect the complete physical series chain and open each channel independently; record loss of isolation/precharge coil current.

obligations.obligation: Carry isolation and precharge relay drive current directly through the high-side shutdown path; emergency buttons, BOTS, master switches and interlocks carry that current themselves.
obligations.verification_obligation: Measure coil drive paths and show there is no low-side substitution, supervisory-only contact or bypass feed.
unresolved_decisions: Coil current and contact ratings TBD; select hardware after worst-case drive-current analysis.

obligations.obligation: Use normally-open BMS, IMD and BSPD shutdown outputs so loss of their sustaining drive opens the path.
obligations.verification_obligation: Remove power and sustaining drive separately from each protective output; observe the open current path.
unresolved_decisions: Relay/contact output topology and parts TBD.

obligations.obligation: BMS, IMD and BSPD interrupt the shutdown path independently; a fault cannot backfeed power into the path.
obligations.verification_obligation: Inject channel, supply and wiring faults; show independent opening and absence of backfeed.
unresolved_decisions: Independent hardware schematic and common-cause/backfeed analysis TBD.

obligations.obligation: Provide a technical-inspection demonstration of every shutdown component, feature and effect.
obligations.verification_obligation: Execute and record a complete vehicle-level demonstration checklist without claiming an unperformed test passed.
unresolved_decisions: Technical-inspection procedure, fixtures and evidence TBD.

obligations.obligation: Open the shutdown circuit upon operation or detection by any required shutdown component and upon any GLV-system shutdown.
obligations.verification_obligation: Inject each independent trip source and GLV loss; prove interruption without relying on software arbitration.

obligations.obligation: An open shutdown circuit stops tractive battery current immediately, disables the tractive system, removes motor torque so motors spin freely, and reduces TS voltage to the T.9.1.2 low-voltage class within five seconds.
obligations.verification_obligation: Measure battery current, motor torque/free-spin and residual voltage after every trip; prove low voltage within 5 s using the applicable T.9.1.2 definition.
unresolved_decisions: Discharge circuit, energy, isolation-relay arrangement and verified timing margins TBD; T.9.1.2 and EV.5.4.3 dependencies need review.

obligations.obligation: Latch BMS, IMD or BSPD trips disabled until a person directly at the vehicle manually resets them. The driver cannot reactivate TS; emergency-button or TSMS operation cannot bypass the latch.
obligations.verification_obligation: Trip each protective device; try driver controls, TSMS, button toggles, remote reset and GLV power cycling. Only a permitted local manual reset after clearing faults releases the latch.
unresolved_decisions: Reset location and independent fail-safe latch hardware TBD; resetting does not itself authorize TS activation.

obligations.obligation: Monitor battery voltage and temperature whenever TS is active or the tractive battery is connected to a charger.
obligations.verification_obligation: Test both active-TS and charger-connected modes, including TS-open charging; inject missing samples in each mode.
unresolved_decisions: Charging integration EV.9.3 and active-state definition EV.12.5 remain dependencies.

obligations.obligation: Provide galvanic isolation at every BMS module-to-module boundary and substantiate it in the ESF.
obligations.verification_obligation: Inspect the module-boundary isolation plan and perform appropriate isolation tests using the approved ESF design.
unresolved_decisions: Battery module configuration, isolation barriers/ratings and approved ESF TBD.

obligations.obligation: Prevent cell balancing whenever the shutdown circuit is open, including charging.
obligations.verification_obligation: Open every shutdown path while requesting balancing in active/charging modes; observe balancing current cease.
unresolved_decisions: Balancing hardware and charging interface EV.9.4 TBD.

obligations.obligation: Detect invalid cell voltage, tripped voltage-sense protection, invalid cell temperature, absent/interrupted measurements and BMS internal faults.
obligations.verification_obligation: Inject each listed fault and distinguish fault detection from a merely plausible last stored sample.
unresolved_decisions: Selected-cell limits, measurement accuracy, sampling and diagnostic implementation TBD.

obligations.obligation: Every detected BMS fault opens shutdown and latches the BMS warning and TS-status indication until manual BMS reset.
obligations.verification_obligation: Inject every BMS fault; verify circuit opening and both indications remain asserted until permitted reset.
unresolved_decisions: TS status indication EV.6.1.6e implementation is a dependent slice.

obligations.obligation: Provide a red driver-visible BMS-marked warning in bright sunlight and perform the EV.6.3 lamp check.
obligations.verification_obligation: Inspect marking/color and seated-driver visibility in bright sunlight; execute the EV.6.3 lamp-check sequence.
unresolved_decisions: Lamp hardware, mounting, brightness and detailed EV.6.3 sequence TBD.

obligations.obligation: Measure each cell voltage; directly parallel-connected cells may share one measurement.
obligations.verification_obligation: Compare every electrical cell group against the sensing-channel map, including conditional direct-parallel grouping.
unresolved_decisions: Exact cells and series/parallel configuration TBD.

obligations.obligation: Maintain cell voltage within the selected manufacturer's minimum/maximum limits with measurement accuracy included.
obligations.verification_obligation: Apply worst-case measurement error and boundary voltages against the selected-cell datasheet; demonstrate trip behavior.
unresolved_decisions: Cell datasheet values and voltage measurement uncertainty TBD; no numerical cell limits are invented.

obligations.obligation: Protect every BMS voltage-sense connection at the directly cell-tab-connected conductor/trace; protection voltage rating is at least maximum module voltage.
obligations.verification_obligation: Inspect cell-tab protection placement, ratings and the blown/tripped-protection fault path.
unresolved_decisions: Module voltage, protection devices, exact tab/trace layout and fault-current ratings TBD.

obligations.obligation: Measure cell temperatures and keep them strictly below the lower of the cell-datasheet maximum and 60 degrees C, including measurement accuracy.
obligations.verification_obligation: Test boundary temperatures with uncertainty; confirm the manufacturer's limit controls whenever it is below 60 degrees C.
unresolved_decisions: Cell temperature limit, sensing uncertainty and thermal placement TBD.

obligations.obligation: Sense at each applicable cell's negative terminal with direct contact to that terminal or its negative-terminal busbar less than 10 mm from the specified weld/clamp location.
obligations.verification_obligation: Inspect sensor contact and negative-terminal location; measure the strict less-than-10-mm alternative where used.
unresolved_decisions: Physical cells, weld/clamp geometry and sensor installation TBD.

obligations.obligation: For lithium-based cells, monitor at least 20 percent, distributed equally across containers; measuring every cell is a recommendation retained separately.
obligations.verification_obligation: If lithium cells are selected, inspect cell count and container distribution and verify at least 20-percent coverage; record the every-cell recommendation separately.
unresolved_decisions: Chemistry, cell count and container configuration TBD; lithium-specific applicability remains conditional.

obligations.obligation: A temperature sensor may represent multiple cells only if all EV.8.5 conditions hold for every sensed cell.
obligations.verification_obligation: If sensors are shared, substantiate contact, coverage and isolation for every represented cell.
unresolved_decisions: Shared-sensor selection and applicability TBD.

obligations.obligation: Provide suitable temperature-sensing isolation at the sensor/cell boundary or in the sensing circuit, accounting for TS/GLV isolation and sense-location common-mode voltage.
obligations.verification_obligation: Test selected isolation barriers at required TS/GLV and common-mode conditions.
unresolved_decisions: Isolation topology, ratings and common-mode envelope TBD.

obligations.obligation: Install an insulation monitor in the tractive system.
obligations.verification_obligation: Inspect the actual tractive-system IMD connections and exercise insulation sensing at the installed interface.

obligations.obligation: Choose an IMD model explicitly approved by the applicable official event Rules FAQ.
obligations.verification_obligation: Compare the selected exact part/model with the pinned applicable official FAQ approval list.
unresolved_decisions: Approved IMD model and applicable official Rules FAQ are TBD; this draft selects no part.

obligations.obligation: Set IMD response to at least 500 ohms per volt of maximum TS operating voltage.
obligations.verification_obligation: Use the actual maximum operating voltage to calculate the response resistance and inject insulation values around the selected threshold.
unresolved_decisions: Maximum operating voltage and resulting resistance setting TBD; the 600-V rule ceiling is not assumed to be the design voltage.

obligations.obligation: Detect insulation failure and IMD malfunction without influence from programmable logic.
obligations.verification_obligation: Inject insulation/monitor faults while stopping or corrupting programmable controllers; prove independent shutdown.
unresolved_decisions: Nonprogrammable IMD safety output and independent wiring details TBD.

obligations.obligation: IMD faults open shutdown and latch IMD warning plus TS-status indication until manual IMD reset.
obligations.verification_obligation: Inject insulation and monitor faults; verify open circuit and retained indications until permitted reset.
unresolved_decisions: TS status indication EV.6.1.6e implementation is a dependent slice.

obligations.obligation: Provide a red driver-visible IMD-marked warning in bright sunlight and perform the EV.6.3 lamp check.
obligations.verification_obligation: Inspect marking/color and seated-driver sunlight visibility; execute the detailed EV.6.3 check.
unresolved_decisions: IMD lamp mounting/brightness and detailed EV.6.3 sequence TBD.

obligations.obligation: Install required interlocks at EV.4.1.3, EV.5.5.2 and EV.7.4.4 interfaces; additional interlocks are permitted, not automatically required.
obligations.verification_obligation: Review all three referenced interfaces, map every required connection and test each break independently.
unresolved_decisions: Exact disconnect/enclosure/connector map and optional additional interlocks TBD; referenced clauses need full review.

obligations.obligation: A broken or interrupted interlock connection opens shutdown.
obligations.verification_obligation: Break each connector/interlock connection and verify isolation/precharge drive current stops.

obligations.obligation: Apply any EV.7.5 interlock-separation exception only after reviewing EV.8.8.4's listed harness, connector and enclosure/location conditions, including the less-than-75-mm condition.
obligations.verification_obligation: Inspect actual routing and evaluate every applicable exception condition and the strict 75-mm boundary.
unresolved_decisions: Routing design and precise applicability of the listed exception conditions TBD; this draft does not automatically waive separation.

obligations.obligation: Provide two directly acting master switches meeting T.9.3 location/configuration; do not substitute relay or logic control.
obligations.verification_obligation: Inspect distinct GLV/TS switches, direct-current contacts and T.9.3 location/configuration.
unresolved_decisions: Switch parts and T.9.3 packaging review TBD.

obligations.obligation: GLVMS stops all GLV power and is labeled LV within a completely red circle greater than 50 mm diameter.
obligations.verification_obligation: Operate GLVMS and measure every GLV supply off; inspect marking/color and a circle strictly larger than 50 mm.
unresolved_decisions: GLV power-distribution completeness and physical switch marking layout TBD.

obligations.obligation: TSMS opens shutdown when OFF; it is the last switch before IRs except precharge circuitry/interlocks, has an orange circle greater than 50 mm, TS/W012 marking and OFF lockout/tagout.
obligations.verification_obligation: Inspect electrical order, OFF opening, lockout/tagout and the required orange area and TS/ISO-7010-W012 marking.
unresolved_decisions: TSMS/contact selection, exact packaging, official symbol implementation and EV.12.3.1 process TBD.

obligations.obligation: Install the three required shutdown buttons: left side, right side and cockpit.
obligations.verification_obligation: Locate and independently operate all three required buttons.

obligations.obligation: Use push-pull or push-rotate emergency switches that open and hold OFF and permit closure ON, while never overriding a latched protective trip.
obligations.verification_obligation: Inspect mechanisms and test hold-OFF/ON behavior both with and without a latched protective trip.
unresolved_decisions: Selected emergency-stop hardware and current ratings TBD.

obligations.obligation: Place left/right buttons aft of the main hoop near the specified bracing junction; each is at least 40 mm diameter and not easily removed or mounted on removable bodywork.
obligations.verification_obligation: Inspect both side installations, retention, bodywork and minimum 40-mm diameter.
unresolved_decisions: Chassis packaging, F.5.9 junction location and mounting/retention design TBD.

obligations.obligation: Place the cockpit button within easy unobstructed reach of the belted driver adjacent to the steering wheel; diameter is at least 24 mm.
obligations.verification_obligation: Test reach with the driver restrained and inspect wheel/other obstructions and minimum 24-mm diameter.
unresolved_decisions: Driver envelope, cockpit geometry and button installation TBD.

obligations.obligation: Place the specified red-spark electrical symbol on a white-edged blue triangle near every shutdown button.
obligations.verification_obligation: Inspect symbol identity and placement beside each of the three buttons.
unresolved_decisions: Final marking artwork and installation TBD.
